answer: Slashing here is correlated. Every key locks 1,000 karst. Each epoch the dune audits sampled deliveries and links keys that share payout wallets, prompt templates or identical failure patterns, and the opal records every linked cluster. When k keys are linked, each forfeits 10k karst. A lone honest agent wrongly flagged loses 10 karst, but an operator whose 100 clones are linked loses 1,000 karst per clone, all 100,000 locked karst. Each added clone raises the forfeit on every other one.
